core_obligations: Recall that the higher direct image is the sheafification of the presheaf sending U to the cohomology of the base change of T along U (proof lines 4040-4046).
Show that for U flat over S the base change U times T over S to T is flat, so that the displayed cohomology group vanishes by the vanishing lemma for parasitic modules (proof lines 4047-4049).
Note that the same holds for every member of any covering of such a U, since the base change of each member is again flat (proof lines 4050-4051).

Conclude that the sheafification of the presheaf is zero on the schemes flat over S, which is exactly the assertion that the pushforward and its higher direct images are parasitic (proof lines 4052-4053).
proof_roadmap: Describe the higher direct images by their presheaf of cohomology groups (proof lines 4040-4046).
Vanishing on flat U by flat base change and the parasitic vanishing lemma (proof lines 4047-4049).
Vanishing on coverings of such U (proof lines 4050-4051).
Conclude vanishing of the sheafification (proof lines 4052-4053).
difficulty_reason: For a morphism of schemes T to S and a parasitic module on the big site of T, the lemma asserts that the pushforward and all higher direct images are parasitic modules on the big site of S (statement lines 4031-4037). The proof computes the higher direct images as the sheafification of the presheaf sending U to the cohomology of the base change of T along U, and then shows that this presheaf vanishes on every U flat over S: the base change of the structure morphism along a flat morphism is flat, so the hypothesis that the module is parasitic makes the cohomology vanish by the preceding lemma of the chapter (proof lines 4039-4049). One further observation is needed, namely that the same vanishing holds on the members of any covering of such a U, so that the sheafification is zero there as well (proof lines 4050-4053). The claim is H2: the description of the higher direct images is recalled with its source, the vanishing is transferred along a flat base change, and the passage to the sheafification is justified rather than assumed, which is what makes the argument complete without any appeal to the sections of the module itself.
